thread:
alex: FYI support flagged a p99 spike for tenant Acme after yesterday's coalesce heuristic rollout (us-west). p95 ~+120ms, p99 ~+1.2s. Anyone oncall?

mika: On it. Dashboards: https://redwood/dashboards/route/acme :eyes:

sanju: I can see the spike lines up with coalesce-policy v2 -> grace_window increased to 6ms for tiny prompts. That reduces token cost but might amplify tail due to late arrivals.

kai: Can you paste the exact config that rolled?

mika: Rolled config snippet: ```json
{"coalesce_policy": "adaptive_v2", "grace_window_ms": 6, "min_batch_size": 2, "max_wait_ms": 12}
```

alex: Customer reports regressions on completions route using gpt-open-3.5-8k-quant; workload = lots of short prompts (~10-20 bytes).

lina: Repro steps I ran locally: spawn 3k 12-char requests at 200 rps -> p99 jumps on some pods. Extract from local run log: ```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] coalesce: hold=9ms size=1 -> exec -> latency=800ms
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] coalesce: hold=2ms size=4 -> exec -> latency=120ms
```

kai: Looks like many singletons hitting the slow kernel path (kernel_init) despite small hold. Could be KV-cache cold path for quantized model.

mika: Traces show span "coalesce_wait"=7-9ms then "kernel_init"=600-800ms when batch size==1.

sanju: Hypothesis: the increased grace window lets more late singletons form and then they still end up as batch size 1, triggering heavy kernel startup overhead. Fixes: (A) reduce grace_window, (B) increase min_batch_size, or (C) special-case batch size 1 to fast-path small-optimized kernel.

alex: Can we hotfix for Acme only? They're on dedicated pool dp-23. This is customer-impacting.

mika: Proposed hotpatch override for route `acme/*` on dp-23: ```yaml
coalesce_policy: adaptive_v2
grace_window_ms: 3
min_batch_size: 4
```

ops-bot: patch request recorded: PR #4827 created by mika

kai: Suggest canary to 10% of dp-23 and watch p99 for 30m before ramp.

lina: I'll run a repro against the canary node after deploy.

mika: Rolling canary now — ops-bot: deploying canary to dp-23/n1 (commit abc123)

ops-bot: canary deploy started (dp-23/n1) — commit abc123

mika: Canary metrics after 5m: p95 back down, p99 reduced ~700ms -> ~130ms improvement vs pre-patch.

alex: Good. Proceed to 50% then full if stable for 1h.

sanju: Long-term fix: add a runtime heuristic to warm kernels for quantized models when batch_size==1 or route sees >X singletons/min. Also add a regression test under tiny_prompts workload to catch this.

kai: I'll open a follow-up RFC and issue for kernel warmup + tiny_prompt fast-path (#4890).

lina: Customer updated support ticket: "latency dropped, thanks" :thumbsup:

alex: Please update incident log and flag for postmortem if we incurred >=30m SLO violation.

mika: Adding notes to PM: https://redwood/pm/latency-acme-coalesce

ops-bot: Alert cleared for Acme p99 spike

mika: Summary: rolled canary override (grace_window_ms -> 3, min_batch_size -> 4) for dp-23 -> immediate p99 improvement. Next: runtime warmup + e2e test + monitor; schedule postmortem if SLO breach confirmed."
